# Brand & Creative
https://gaa-tha.com/services/brand-and-creative

Brands people remember and content people stop for.

Brand & Creative is the gaa-tha practice that decides what a brand looks, sounds and feels like — and then makes the assets: identity systems, graphic design, reels, AI ads, cinema films, product photography, copy and sales kits. Every service below is delivered by the same in-house team, so the story stays consistent across all of them.

## FAQ
Q: What does a brand and creative agency do?
A: A brand and creative agency defines how a business looks, sounds and behaves (identity, tone, guidelines) and produces the creative that carries it: social content, reels, ad films, packaging, catalogues and product imagery. gaa-tha runs both halves under one roof so the identity and the daily content never drift apart.

Q: Do I need branding before I start marketing?
A: Usually yes, at least a minimum viable identity: a logo, colours, type and a tone of voice. Marketing spends money to make people notice you; branding decides what they remember. If you already have an identity that works, we build on it rather than replacing it.

Q: Can you produce creative at volume every month?
A: Yes. Reels, graphic design and AI imagery run on monthly retainers with a content calendar, and our AI-assisted production pipeline lets us ship batches in days. Art direction stays human so the output looks like your brand, not like a template.

Q: Do you do real shoots as well as AI-generated creative?
A: Both. We plan and direct on-ground shoots for reels and films, produce AI ad shoots when speed or SKU count makes a physical shoot impractical, and often blend the two.

Q: Which industries is this for?
A: FMCG and food, D2C beauty, retail, manufacturing and B2B, real estate and education are the categories we work in most. The process is the same; the references and channels change.


## Branding & Brand Identity
https://gaa-tha.com/services/branding-agency
Last updated: 2026-09-25

gaa-tha is a branding agency in India that builds the name, look, voice and rules that make a brand recognisable everywhere — from a 16px favicon to a 40-foot hoarding. Discovery workshop, positioning and brand story, logo and visual system, tone of voice, packaging direction and a guidelines PDF, delivered as a one-time project in two to four weeks.

Best for: New launches, rebrands and legacy businesses modernising — for example manufacturers moving into B2B export
Timeline: 2–4 weeks
Engagement model: One-time project, with optional retainer for ongoing design
Channels/platforms: Logo, print, packaging, social, website, signage and hoardings

### What it is
Brand identity is the complete system of name, logo, colour, typography, imagery, tone of voice and usage rules that lets people recognise a business before they read a word. It is the difference between a logo file and a brand: the logo is one asset, the identity is the set of decisions that keeps every asset looking and sounding like the same company.

At gaa-tha branding starts with the story, not the sketch. A discovery workshop with the founders sets the positioning and the one idea the brand stands for; the logo, colour, type and graphic system are then designed to carry that idea across a favicon, a WhatsApp post, a pack of snacks and a highway hoarding, and written into a guidelines PDF so the identity survives new designers, printers and platforms.

### What's included
- Brand discovery workshop with founders and the sales team
- Positioning, brand story and messaging pillars
- Naming and sub-brand naming support
- Logo design or logo refresh, with responsive versions from favicon to hoarding
- Colour, typography and graphic system
- Tone of voice and writing rules
- Stationery and collateral: visiting cards, letterheads, email signatures
- Packaging direction and label system
- Brand guidelines PDF
- Social media templates for Instagram, LinkedIn and WhatsApp

### How we work
1. Discover — A half-day workshop with the founders covers the origin story, customers, competitors, ambitions and what must not change. We audit the current identity and every surface it appears on.
2. Position — We write the positioning, brand story and messaging pillars, and agree them before any visual work starts, so the design has something to say.
3. Design — Two or three logo and identity directions are presented as real mock-ups — packaging, hoarding, Instagram grid, website — not on white paper. One direction is chosen and refined.
4. Build the system — Colour, type, graphic devices, photography style, stationery, packaging direction and social templates are built out and tested at every size.
5. Hand over — You receive the guidelines PDF, all source and export files and a launch checklist; we can then roll the identity out across your website, socials and print.

### Deliverables
- Positioning and brand story document
- Primary logo, secondary marks and favicon in SVG, PNG and PDF with Illustrator and Figma source
- Colour, typography and graphic system with usage rules
- Brand guidelines PDF
- Stationery and collateral files ready for print
- Editable social media templates in Canva or Figma
- Packaging or label direction with dielines where required

Tools & platforms: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Canva, Google Fonts, Adobe Fonts, Notion
Pricing model: One-time project fee scoped to the number of deliverables (logo only, identity system, or full rebrand with packaging and collateral); rollout across website, social and print is quoted separately.

### FAQ
Q: What does a brand identity include?
A: A brand identity includes the logo and its variants, the colour palette, typography, graphic devices and imagery style, tone of voice, and the rules for using all of them — usually collected in a brand guidelines document. It often also covers stationery, social templates and packaging direction. gaa-tha delivers all of these in one project so nothing is left to interpretation later.

Q: How much does branding cost in India?
A: Branding fees in India vary widely: a logo-only job from a freelancer costs a small fraction of a full identity system with research, packaging and rollout from a studio, and the price follows the depth of discovery, the number of deliverables and the seniority of the team. gaa-tha quotes a fixed project fee after a short call, scoped to exactly what you need, so there is no open-ended billing.

Q: Can you refresh our logo without losing recognition?
A: Yes. A logo refresh keeps the elements people already recognise — usually the symbol, the colour or the name lockup — and fixes what is dated: proportions, typography, legibility at small sizes and how it works in a single colour. We test the refreshed mark next to the old one on your actual packaging and signage before you commit.

Q: How long does a rebrand take?
A: Two to four weeks for the identity itself, from discovery workshop to guidelines. Rollout across website, packaging, signage and social depends on how many surfaces you have and on printer lead times, and usually runs a further two to six weeks.

Q: Do we get the source files?
A: Yes. You receive editable source files in Adobe Illustrator and Figma, exports in SVG, PNG and PDF, and the fonts or licence links, along with the guidelines. The identity is yours outright; nothing is held back behind a retainer.

Q: Do I need branding before I start marketing?
A: Usually yes, at least a minimum viable identity: logo, colours, type and a tone of voice. Marketing spends money to make people notice you; branding decides what they remember. If your current identity works, we build on it rather than replacing it.

Q: Can you handle packaging and labels?
A: Yes. We set the packaging direction as part of the identity — hierarchy, colour coding by variant, space for mandatory declarations such as FSSAI and MRP panels — and design labels and boxes to your printer's dielines. Regulatory text is checked with you before print.

Q: Do you rename businesses?
A: We do, when a name is blocking growth: too generic to trademark, too local for export, or too close to a competitor. Naming includes shortlists checked for domain availability, social handles and a preliminary trademark search, with the final legal search done by your trademark attorney.


## Graphic Design
https://gaa-tha.com/services/graphic-design
Last updated: 2026-09-25

gaa-tha's graphic design service produces campaign, social, print and packaging creative that makes a message clearer, faster and more trustworthy: Instagram posts and carousels, hoardings and transit ads, standees and in-store POS, labels, brochures, sales decks and infographics — designed by one team on a monthly retainer or per project, with most sets delivered in two to seven days.

Best for: Brands running always-on social content or seasonal campaigns across social, print and in-store
Timeline: 2–7 days per set
Engagement model: Monthly retainer or per project
Channels/platforms: Instagram, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, hoardings, transit, print, packaging, in-store

### What it is
Graphic design is the craft of arranging type, colour, image and space so a message is understood quickly and trusted — on a social post, a hoarding, a product label or a sales deck. Good design is not decoration; it decides what a person reads first, what they feel about the brand, and whether they act.

gaa-tha runs graphic design as a production line with an art director at the front. Every brief starts from the brand guidelines and the campaign idea, is designed once for the lead format, then adapted correctly to every size — Instagram carousel, WhatsApp creative, auto-rickshaw panel, bus shelter, standee, catalogue page — so a festive campaign in Surat or Ahmedabad looks the same on the road as it does on the phone.

### What's included
- Social media posts, carousels and stories for Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook
- WhatsApp broadcast creatives and status designs
- Hoardings, banners and outdoor adaptations
- Auto-rickshaw, bus and other transit creatives
- Standees, danglers, shelf talkers and in-store POS
- Catalogues, brochures and leaflets
- Product labels and packaging artwork on print-ready dielines
- Presentations and sales decks
- Infographics and explainer visuals
- Print-ready files with bleed, CMYK conversion and printer coordination

### How we work
1. Brief — Each request comes in on a shared tracker with the objective, the message, the formats and the deadline. We ask the questions that stop revisions later.
2. Concept — The lead creative is designed first — the hero post, the master hoarding or the catalogue cover — and shared for one round of direction.
3. Adapt — The approved concept is adapted to every size and surface with correct safe areas, resolution and colour profile for screen or print.
4. Review — Two rounds of revisions are built into every set; copy, prices, dates and mandatory text are checked against the brief before release.
5. Release and archive — Final files go out in the formats each channel needs, and everything is filed in your shared brand library so it can be reused.

### Deliverables
- Monthly creative sets aligned to a content calendar
- Print-ready PDFs with bleed and crop marks for hoardings, transit and POS
- Social-ready exports in every platform size
- Editable source files in Figma, Illustrator or Canva
- A shared brand asset library organised by campaign
- Packaging artwork on printer dielines with a proof approval

Tools & platforms: Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe InDesign, Canva, Midjourney, Google Drive
Pricing model: Monthly retainer priced by the number of creative sets per month, or a per-project fee for one-off campaigns, catalogues and packaging; printing is billed by the printer directly.

### FAQ
Q: What does a graphic design agency do?
A: A graphic design agency turns a brand's messages into visual assets: social posts, ads, hoardings, packaging, catalogues, decks and infographics, designed to the brand's guidelines and to the technical specs of each channel. gaa-tha runs this as an ongoing retainer for brands that need creative every week, and per project for launches and festive campaigns.

Q: How many designs can you deliver in a month?
A: It depends on the mix: a retainer might cover twenty to forty social creatives plus a few print or outdoor adaptations, while a catalogue or packaging job is scoped separately. We agree a monthly volume and a turnaround of two to seven days per set, and scale up around Diwali, Navratri or a launch.

Q: Do you design for print and outdoor as well as social?
A: Yes. Hoardings, auto-rickshaw and bus creatives, standees, shelf talkers, brochures and packaging are all part of the service, delivered as print-ready PDFs with bleed, crop marks and CMYK colour. We coordinate with your printer or vendor on sizes and materials so nothing gets resized badly on site.

Q: Do you use AI in graphic design?
A: Yes, where it helps: AI image generation for backgrounds, product scenes and concept boards, and AI-assisted resizing for large adaptation sets. Layout, typography, brand consistency and final judgement stay with a human designer, and every output is checked against your guidelines.

Q: Can you work within our existing brand guidelines?
A: Yes. Most retainers start with a brand we did not create. We audit the guidelines and existing assets, build a working template library in the first week, and flag gaps — a missing dark-background logo, no Gujarati or Hindi type pairing — for you to decide on.

Q: What if we do not have brand guidelines?
A: We can design from your existing logo and assets while we set a light system — colours, type, layout rules — in the first month. If you need a proper identity, our branding service builds it and the design retainer then runs on top of it.

Q: How do revisions work?
A: Every set includes two rounds of revisions. Feedback is collected in one place on a shared tracker so the whole team's comments arrive together, and changes to copy, prices or dates after final approval are handled as a quick fix rather than a new job.

Q: Which file formats do we receive?
A: Social creatives as PNG or JPG in every platform size, print as PDF with bleed, packaging as PDF on dielines, and editable sources in Figma, Illustrator or Canva as agreed at the start. Everything is stored in a shared Google Drive brand library that stays yours.


## Reels & Short-form Video
https://gaa-tha.com/services/reels-short-form-video
Last updated: 2026-09-25

gaa-tha produces Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and short-form video built to be re-watched: content pillars and a monthly calendar, scripts with a hook in the first second, on-ground shoot direction, editing with captions and sound design, UGC-style and founder-led formats, and a monthly review of retention, saves and shares — delivered in three-to-seven-day batches on a monthly retainer.

Best for: D2C, FMCG, retail, real estate and education brands that need to show up every week
Timeline: 3–7 days per batch
Engagement model: Monthly retainer with a fixed number of reels
Channels/platforms: Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp status, Meta ads

### What it is
Short-form video is vertical video of roughly 90 seconds or less made for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and similar feeds, where the platform decides who sees it based on how long people watch, whether they rewatch, and whether they save or share it. A reel earns reach by holding attention, not by being posted.

gaa-tha treats every reel as a small piece of engineering: a hook written for the first second, a structure that gives a reason to keep watching, captions for sound-off viewing, and a clear next step. Content pillars are set monthly, shoots are planned so one day on the ground yields a full batch, and each batch is reviewed on retention, saves and shares before the next one is scripted.

### What's included
- Content pillars, formats and a monthly reels calendar
- Scripting with hook, structure and CTA for every reel
- Shoot planning: locations, props, talent and shot list
- On-ground shoot direction at your store, factory, site or office
- Editing, captions, colour and sound design
- UGC-style, founder-led and product-demo formats
- Trend and audio adaptation within brand tone
- Cover frames, captions and hashtag sets ready for posting
- Cut-downs and versions for Meta ads and WhatsApp
- Monthly performance review of retention, saves, shares and follows

### How we work
1. Pillars and calendar — We define three to five content pillars from your positioning and audience, then plan a month of reels against them.
2. Script — Every reel gets a written hook, beat-by-beat structure and CTA. You approve scripts before anyone picks up a camera.
3. Shoot — One planned shoot day covers a batch — your outlet, factory, site or a founder on camera — with a shot list that makes the edit fast.
4. Edit and deliver — Reels are cut with captions, sound design and brand-matched colour, delivered in three to seven days with cover frames and captions ready to post.
5. Review and refine — Each month we read retention curves, saves, shares and profile visits, keep what works, and rewrite the next calendar around it.

### Deliverables
- Monthly reels calendar with pillars and approved scripts
- Finished reels in 9:16 with captions and cover frames
- Post captions, hashtag sets and a posting schedule
- Ad-ready cut-downs in 15- and 30-second versions where needed
- Raw footage archive on a shared drive
- Monthly retention and engagement review

Tools & platforms: Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Meta Business Suite, Google Sheets
Pricing model: Monthly retainer priced by the number of reels per month and shoot days; travel outside Gujarat and paid talent are quoted at cost.

### FAQ
Q: What makes a reel perform on Instagram?
A: Watch time. Instagram distributes reels that people watch to the end, rewatch, save or share, so the first second has to promise something, the middle has to keep delivering, and the length has to match the idea. Consistent posting and a recognisable format help both the algorithm and the audience know what to expect from you.

Q: How many reels should a brand post per month?
A: Eight to twelve is a realistic starting point for most brands — two to three a week is enough to learn what works without burning the team out. Volume matters less than consistency and a clear set of formats; we would rather ship ten good reels a month than thirty forgettable ones.

Q: Do you shoot the reels or only edit them?
A: Both. We plan and direct on-ground shoots at your store, factory, showroom or site, and we also edit footage you shoot yourself on a phone using our shot lists. Most retainers combine one planned shoot day a month with founder or team footage in between.

Q: Do we need to be on camera?
A: It helps, but it is not required. Founder-led reels build trust fastest for services, real estate and education brands; product-led, UGC-style and voiceover formats work well for FMCG and D2C brands whose founders prefer to stay off camera. An AI digital spokesperson is also an option for brands that want a consistent face without daily shoots.

Q: How long does a batch take?
A: Three to seven days from shoot to delivery for a batch of reels, once scripts are approved. The first month takes a little longer because pillars, formats and shoot logistics are being set up.

Q: Can the same reels be used as ads?
A: Yes, and they should be. We deliver ad-ready cut-downs with the hook tightened and a clear offer, and our Meta ads team tests them alongside static creatives. Organic reels tell us which hooks earn attention before money is spent on them.

Q: Do you follow trends?
A: Selectively. Trending audio and formats are adapted when they fit your brand tone and your audience, and we skip the ones that would look off-brand. Original formats you can repeat are what build a following; trends are the seasoning.

Q: Which industries do you make reels for?
A: D2C and FMCG brands, retail chains, real estate, education, manufacturers and B2B companies. The formats change — product demos and recipes for food, walkthroughs for real estate, founder explainers for B2B — but the process is the same.


## AI Ads & AI Ad Shoots
https://gaa-tha.com/services/ai-ads-ai-ad-shoots
Last updated: 2026-09-25

gaa-tha's AI ads and AI ad shoots produce premium product and model creatives with generative AI and human art direction — shoot-quality output in three to ten days at a fraction of traditional production cost. Product hero visuals, lifestyle and model scenes, festive campaign sets, AI video ads, ad variations for testing and catalogue imagery, graded to your brand.

Best for: Brands with many SKUs or frequent campaigns — FMCG, D2C beauty, fashion, jewellery, real estate
Timeline: 3–10 days per set
Engagement model: Per campaign or monthly retainer
Channels/platforms: Meta ads, Instagram, marketplaces, quick commerce, print, hoardings

### What it is
An AI ad shoot is the production of product, model and lifestyle imagery or video using generative AI tools instead of a physical set, camera crew and location, with a human art director controlling composition, light, styling and brand consistency. The output is used the same way a photoshoot would be: ads, social posts, listings, catalogues and outdoor.

gaa-tha's pipeline starts with your real product — its pack, its colours, its details — and builds scenes around it: a kitchen in Mumbai, a Diwali table, a monsoon street, a studio with soft light. Each campaign set is art-directed, graded and typeset to your guidelines, checked for pack accuracy, and delivered in every ad size, with variations so the performance team can test hooks and offers without waiting for a reshoot.

### What's included
- Product hero visuals on studio, textured and brand-colour backgrounds
- Lifestyle and model scenes with consistent characters across a campaign
- Festive and seasonal campaign sets: Diwali, Navratri, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, Christmas and New Year
- AI video ads, motion loops and animated product reveals
- Ad variations for A/B testing: hooks, offers, backgrounds and formats
- Catalogue and listing imagery for Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit and Shopify
- Brand-matched colour grading, typography and layout
- Pack accuracy and claims check before release
- Exports in every Meta, Google, marketplace and print size

### How we work
1. Brief and references — We collect your products, pack files, brand guidelines and campaign objective, and agree the mood, scenes and number of variations.
2. Concept boards — Two or three visual directions are generated as boards for you to choose from before full production starts.
3. Produce — The chosen direction is produced at scale — hero shots, lifestyle scenes, models, motion — with the art director controlling consistency.
4. Retouch and typeset — Every image is checked for pack accuracy and artefacts, then retouched, graded and typeset with offer, price and CTA where needed.
5. Deliver and test — Files go out in every size with variation sets labelled for testing; performance data comes back to shape the next batch.

### Deliverables
- Campaign set of art-directed product and lifestyle images
- AI video ads or motion pieces in 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9
- Variation sets labelled for Meta and Google ad testing
- Listing-ready images for marketplaces and quick commerce
- Layered source files and a shared asset library
- Usage notes on where each asset can and cannot be used

Tools & platforms: Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Kling, Adobe Photoshop, Figma, Meta Ads Manager
Pricing model: Per-campaign fee scoped to the number of finished images, videos and variations, or a monthly retainer for brands that need fresh sets every month; no location, crew or talent costs.

### FAQ
Q: What are AI ads and AI ad shoots?
A: AI ads are ad creatives — images, videos, variations — produced with generative AI tools under human art direction instead of a physical photoshoot. An AI ad shoot is the same idea applied to a whole campaign or catalogue: consistent scenes, models and lighting across dozens of assets. gaa-tha produces both and pairs them with its performance team so the creatives are tested, not just delivered.

Q: Will the product look exactly like our real product?
A: Yes, that is the point of the process. We start from your actual pack files and product photography, generate the scene around the product rather than the product itself where accuracy matters, and run a pack check on labels, logos, colours and proportions before anything is released. Mandatory declarations are never altered.

Q: How is this different from stock photos or templates?
A: Stock is generic and used by everyone; templates look like templates. An AI ad shoot is art-directed for your brand, your product and your campaign, with scenes, models and light chosen for your audience in India, and the assets are exclusive to you.

Q: Can you make AI videos as well as images?
A: Yes. Product reveals, motion loops, lifestyle clips and short video ads are produced with AI video tools and finished in the edit with sound, captions and brand typography. For longer or story-led films see our cinema and film ads service, which often blends AI and live-action.

Q: How long does an AI ad shoot take?
A: Three to ten days from brief to delivery depending on the number of scenes, variations and video pieces. Concept boards usually arrive within two to three days so the direction is agreed early.

Q: Do you still do real photoshoots?
A: Yes. Some products, faces and moments need a camera — a founder, a store, a texture that has to be exact — and we plan and direct those shoots too. Most brands end up with a blend: a real hero shoot plus AI sets for volume, seasons and testing.

Q: Is it safe to use AI-generated ads in India?
A: Generally yes for imagery you commission and own, as long as the ad is truthful, follows the ASCI advertising code, and does not use a real person's likeness without consent. We use licensed tools, avoid real-person likenesses unless there is a signed consent, and label AI-generated spokespersons where a platform or regulator requires it.

Q: Can AI creatives be used on marketplaces and quick commerce?
A: Yes, provided the main image follows each platform's rules — for example a plain white background and no added text on Amazon's primary image — and the product itself is accurately shown. We produce compliant primary images and use AI lifestyle and infographic images in the secondary slots and A+ content.


## Cinema & Film Ads
https://gaa-tha.com/services/cinema-ads-film-production
Last updated: 2026-09-25

gaa-tha makes cinema and film ads — trailer-grade product films, shot or AI-produced, cut for theatre screens, OTT, YouTube and in-store displays. Concept and script, storyboard, production, sound design mixed for cinema audio, 10-, 20- and 30-second cuts, 2.39:1 scope and vertical versions, plus support with cinema media planning, delivered per film in one to three weeks.

Best for: Retail chains, FMCG launches, festive campaigns and local brands wanting city-wide recall
Timeline: 1–3 weeks per film
Engagement model: Per film; cinema screen time booked separately
Channels/platforms: Multiplex and single-screen cinemas, OTT, YouTube, Instagram, in-store screens

### What it is
A cinema ad is a short film — usually 10 to 30 seconds — screened before the feature in multiplexes and single-screen theatres, where a captive audience watches it on a large screen with full surround sound and no skip button. The same film is then cut for OTT pre-rolls, YouTube, Instagram and in-store screens so the recall it builds is reinforced everywhere.

gaa-tha produces cinema ads as live-action shoots, as AI-generated films, or as a blend of the two, which is how most brands get trailer-grade visuals inside a local budget. Every film is written for a large screen first — composition in 2.39:1 scope, sound designed for cinema audio — and then reframed for vertical and square, so a Surat retail chain or a Gujarat FMCG launch is seen in the multiplex one evening and on Instagram the next morning.

### What's included
- Concept, script and voiceover copy in English, Hindi or Gujarati
- Storyboard and shot list
- Live-action production: crew, location, talent and direction
- AI-generated production for scenes a shoot cannot afford
- Edit, colour grade and motion graphics
- Sound design and mix built for cinema audio and for mobile speakers
- 10-, 20- and 30-second cuts
- 2.39:1 scope master plus 16:9, 1:1 and 9:16 versions
- In-store screen loops and captioned silent versions
- Cinema media planning support: screen selection, DCP delivery and certification guidance

### How we work
1. Concept — We start from the campaign objective — launch, festive, footfall — and write two or three film ideas with a one-line story each.
2. Script and storyboard — The chosen idea becomes a script, storyboard and shot list, with the production route decided: live-action, AI or a blend.
3. Produce — Shoot days are planned and directed, or AI scenes are generated under the same art direction; the founder or product is filmed for real where it matters.
4. Post-production — Edit, colour, motion graphics, voiceover and a cinema-grade sound mix, reviewed at full scale before the final cuts.
5. Deliver and distribute — Masters go out in every format with the DCP-ready file and certification guidance for cinema; we support media booking and cut the same film for OTT, YouTube and in-store screens.

### Deliverables
- Approved script and storyboard
- Master film in 2.39:1 scope, plus 16:9, 1:1 and 9:16 versions
- 10-, 20- and 30-second cuts with cinema-mixed audio
- DCP-ready export and certification guidance
- In-store screen loop and captioned silent version
- Stills pulled from the film for hoardings and social
- Raw footage and project files archived on a shared drive

Tools & platforms: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe After Effects, Runway, Kling, Midjourney, ElevenLabs, Adobe Audition
Pricing model: Per-film fee scoped to production route (live-action, AI or blend), duration and number of versions; cinema screen time, DCP mastering and certification fees are paid to the vendors directly.

### FAQ
Q: Do you make cinema ads?
A: Yes. gaa-tha writes, produces and delivers cinema ads for multiplexes and single-screen theatres, as live-action shoots, AI-generated films or a blend, and cuts the same film for OTT, YouTube, Instagram and in-store screens. We also support cinema media planning so the film reaches the right screens in the right cities.

Q: How much does a cinema ad cost in India?
A: It depends far more on production than on screen time: a live-action shoot with crew, location and talent costs more than an AI-produced film, and a 30-second film with multiple versions costs more than a 10-second cut. Screen time is booked per screen per week and varies by city, theatre and film release. We quote the production as a fixed fee and share the media rates from the cinema advertising network before you commit.

Q: How long does it take to produce a cinema ad?
A: One to three weeks from concept to deliverable masters. AI-produced films sit at the shorter end; live-action shoots with talent and locations at the longer end. Certification and cinema scheduling add time on top, so plan four to six weeks ahead of a festive release.

Q: What formats do cinemas need?
A: Most Indian multiplexes and cinema advertising networks accept a DCP (Digital Cinema Package) or a high-bitrate video file in 2.39:1 scope or 16:9 flat, with a 5.1 or stereo mix, along with a CBFC certificate for the ad. We deliver the master to the spec of your chosen network and guide you through certification.

Q: Can the same film run on OTT, YouTube and Instagram?
A: Yes, and it should. Every cinema film is reframed and remixed for 16:9 pre-rolls and 1:1 and 9:16 social, with captions for sound-off viewing, so the story people saw on the big screen is reinforced on their phone.

Q: Can a small local business afford a cinema ad?
A: Increasingly, yes. AI-generated production removes crew, location and talent costs, and cinema networks sell screen time by city and theatre, so a retail chain in Vadodara or a sweets brand in Vapi can run a trailer-grade film in the theatres its customers actually visit. We size the production route and the screen plan to the budget.

Q: Do you handle the CBFC certification?
A: We prepare the film and the paperwork to the certification requirements and guide you through the application; the certificate is issued in the advertiser's name. Timelines vary, so we build them into the plan from the start.

Q: Will an AI-produced film look like an AI film?
A: Not if it is art-directed properly. We write scenes AI renders convincingly, keep real footage of the product and people where accuracy matters, grade everything consistently and mix the sound for the big screen. Every film is reviewed at full scale before release.


## AI Cloning (Digital Spokesperson)
https://gaa-tha.com/services/ai-cloning-spokesperson
Last updated: 2026-09-25

AI cloning at gaa-tha creates a consent-first digital twin of your founder or spokesperson: voice and likeness captured once, then used to produce on-camera videos from a script without a daily shoot. Setup takes one to two weeks and covers a consent and usage agreement, capture, script-to-video production, Hindi, Gujarati and English versions, and brand approval on every output.

Best for: Founder-led brands, educators, real-estate developers, clinics and B2B companies that need to publish video weekly
Timeline: 1–2 weeks setup, then monthly
Engagement model: One-time setup plus monthly production
Channels/platforms: Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, website, sales decks, ads

### What it is
AI cloning, or a digital spokesperson, is a licensed digital twin of a real person — their face, voice and mannerisms captured with consent — that can deliver new scripts on camera without the person being filmed each time. It lets a founder appear in weekly explainers, product updates, festival greetings and ads in several languages while spending a single afternoon in front of a camera.

gaa-tha runs the service consent-first: a written agreement sets what the twin may say, where it may appear and who approves each video, and every output goes through that approval before it is published. Scripts are written by our content team in your tone of voice, produced with the twin in Hindi, Gujarati, English or other languages, and finished with captions, B-roll and brand graphics so the videos look like the rest of your content.

### What's included
- Consent and usage agreement covering rights, scope, approvals and revocation
- Voice and likeness capture session with scripted and conversational footage
- Digital twin creation and quality testing
- Script-to-video production from your content calendar
- Multilingual versions with lip-sync in Hindi, Gujarati, English and other languages
- Captions, B-roll, brand graphics and music
- Brand-approval workflow on every output before publishing
- Secure storage and access control for the twin
- Monthly review of what performed and next month's scripts

### How we work
1. Consent and scope — We agree in writing what the digital spokesperson will be used for, on which platforms, who approves each video, and how consent can be withdrawn.
2. Capture — A half-day session records the face and voice in the right conditions — scripted lines, natural conversation, a few expressions — so the twin looks and sounds like the person.
3. Build and test — The twin is created and tested with real scripts; the founder reviews and signs off on how it looks and sounds before any content is produced.
4. Produce — Each month scripts are written from your calendar, produced with the twin, finished with captions and graphics, and sent for approval.
5. Publish and review — Approved videos go out on your channels or into ads; we review performance monthly and adjust formats, lengths and languages.

### Deliverables
- Signed consent and usage agreement
- Tested digital twin (voice and likeness) with founder sign-off
- Monthly batch of approved spokesperson videos in 9:16 and 16:9
- Multilingual versions with captions
- Approval log for every published video
- Access-controlled asset store

Tools & platforms: HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Synthesia, Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Google Drive, Notion
Pricing model: One-time setup fee for consent, capture and twin creation, then a monthly production fee scoped to the number of videos and languages; the twin is used only under your written agreement.

### FAQ
Q: What is AI cloning or a digital spokesperson?
A: It is a licensed digital twin of a real person, built from consented recordings of their face and voice, that can deliver new scripts on camera without a fresh shoot. Brands use it to publish weekly explainers, product updates, greetings and ads featuring their founder or a brand ambassador. gaa-tha sets it up in one to two weeks and produces the monthly videos.

Q: Is AI cloning ethical and legal?
A: It is, when it is done with the person's informed written consent, used within the agreed scope, and disclosed where the platform or law requires. Our process starts with a consent and usage agreement, keeps approval with the person or the brand on every output, and lets consent be withdrawn. We do not clone anyone without their agreement.

Q: Will viewers be able to tell it is AI?
A: Modern twins are convincing for talking-head formats, especially with good capture footage and a script written in the person's natural speech. We recommend disclosing the use of a digital spokesperson in your bio or captions where appropriate; audiences respond well to honesty, and the content still saves the founder's time.

Q: What do we need for the setup?
A: One person willing to be captured, a half-day recording session, a few examples of how they normally speak, your brand guidelines and a first month's list of topics. Setup takes one to two weeks from capture to sign-off.

Q: Can the spokesperson speak Hindi, Gujarati and other languages?
A: Yes. The twin can deliver scripts in Hindi, Gujarati, English and other languages with matching lip-sync, which is useful for brands selling across states or to export markets. A native speaker checks each language version before approval.

Q: What can and cannot the twin be used for?
A: That is defined in the agreement. Typical scope is brand content, explainers, ads and internal training; typical exclusions are political content, endorsements of other brands, and anything the person would not say themselves. The founder or brand approves every video before it is published.

Q: Who owns the digital twin?
A: The person and the brand, as set out in the agreement. gaa-tha holds the working files under access control only for the duration of the engagement, and the twin is never used for another client or purpose.

Q: Does this replace real shoots?
A: It replaces the daily grind of being on camera, not the moments that need to be real — a factory walk, a customer meeting, a launch. Most brands pair a monthly real shoot for reels with the digital spokesperson for the weekly updates in between.


## Ecommerce Product Photography
https://gaa-tha.com/services/product-photography-ecommerce
Last updated: 2026-09-25

gaa-tha produces ecommerce product photography and catalogue imagery made to each platform's specifications: white-background packshots, lifestyle scenes, infographic and 'why buy' images, pack-size visuals, A+ content modules, Shopify collection covers and quick-commerce thumbnails, so listings on Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit and your own store look premium and convert. Delivered in five to fifteen days depending on SKU count.

Best for: D2C brands, FMCG companies and marketplace sellers with 10 to 1,000+ SKUs
Timeline: 5–15 days depending on SKU count
Engagement model: Per SKU or per catalogue, with a retainer for new launches
Channels/platforms: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Shopify

### What it is
Ecommerce product photography is the set of images a product needs to sell online: a compliant white-background main image, alternate angles, lifestyle scenes showing it in use, infographic images that answer the buyer's questions, scale and pack-size visuals, and the A+ or enhanced-content modules that platforms such as Amazon and Flipkart allow. The main image wins the click; the rest win the purchase.

gaa-tha shoots and builds these to each platform's rules — Amazon's pure-white primary image, Blinkit and Zepto's small square thumbnails that must read at a glance, Shopify collection covers that set the brand's tone. For large catalogues we combine a real packshot of every SKU with AI-assisted lifestyle and infographic sets, so 200 products can be made consistent in weeks rather than months.

### What's included
- White-background packshots: front, back, sides and 45-degree angles
- Lifestyle images in real or AI-generated settings
- Infographic and 'why buy' images with benefits, ingredients and specifications
- Size, scale and pack-size comparison visuals
- A+ / enhanced brand content modules for Amazon and Flipkart
- Shopify collection covers, product-page galleries and banners
- Quick-commerce thumbnails for Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart
- Retouching, colour correction and background clean-up
- AI-assisted shoots for large catalogues
- Export in every platform's size, format and naming convention

### How we work
1. Audit and spec sheet — We list every SKU and every platform, pull the current image rules for each, and define the image set each product needs.
2. Shoot planning — Products are collected or shot at your location; lighting, angles and props are standardised so the whole catalogue looks like one family.
3. Shoot — Packshots are photographed for every SKU; hero products get lifestyle and detail shots; large catalogues use AI-assisted sets for lifestyle and infographic scenes.
4. Retouch and build — Images are cleaned and colour-matched to the real product, and infographic and A+ modules are designed with copy from your product data.
5. Deliver and upload — Files go out named and sized per platform; our marketplace and Shopify teams can upload them and check them live on the listings.

### Deliverables
- Compliant main images for every SKU and platform
- Full image set per product: angles, lifestyle, infographics and scale
- A+ / enhanced content modules ready to upload
- Shopify collection covers and product-page galleries
- Quick-commerce thumbnails at each platform's size
- Organised master library with platform-specific exports

Tools & platforms: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Lightroom, Capture One, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Figma, Amazon Seller Central, Shopify
Pricing model: Per-SKU or per-catalogue fee based on the number of products and the image set each needs (packshot only, full set, A+ modules); AI-assisted sets for large catalogues are quoted per batch.

### FAQ
Q: Do you create product images and A+ content?
A: Yes. gaa-tha shoots white-background packshots, lifestyle and infographic images, and designs A+ / enhanced brand content modules for Amazon and Flipkart, Shopify galleries and quick-commerce thumbnails. Everything is delivered to each platform's size and rules, and our marketplace team can upload it for you.

Q: What are Amazon's product image requirements?
A: The main image must show the product on a pure white background, filling most of the frame, with no text, logos, watermarks or props, in JPEG or PNG at a size large enough to zoom. Secondary images can show lifestyle, infographics and scale. Amazon updates these rules from time to time, so we check the current guidelines for your category before every shoot.

Q: How many images does each product need?
A: Six to eight is a good target on Amazon and Flipkart: the main packshot, two or three angles, one or two lifestyle images, an infographic and a scale shot. Quick-commerce platforms need mainly one strong thumbnail; Shopify benefits from a gallery plus a collection cover.

Q: How long does a catalogue shoot take?
A: Five to fifteen days depending on SKU count and the image set per product. A 20-SKU packshot job sits at the short end; a 200-SKU catalogue with lifestyle and A+ modules at the long end, often delivered in weekly batches so uploads can start early.

Q: Do you use AI for product photography?
A: For lifestyle scenes, infographic backgrounds and large catalogues, yes; for the product itself we prefer a real packshot so colours, labels and proportions are exact. AI scenes are built around the real product image, and every output is checked against the physical product before delivery.

Q: Do we need to ship the products to you?
A: For small catalogues, yes — products are couriered to us and returned. For large or fragile catalogues we shoot at your factory, warehouse or store in Gujarat and nearby cities with a portable setup.

Q: Can you fix our existing product images?
A: Often, yes. Background clean-up, colour correction, re-cropping to platform rules and adding infographic layers can rescue a decent existing shoot. If the originals are low-resolution or badly lit, a reshoot of the main image is the faster route to better conversion.

Q: Will better images actually improve sales?
A: Images are the first thing a marketplace buyer judges, and the main image is what earns the click from a search page, so image quality affects both click-through and conversion. We do not promise a number, but we track click-through and conversion rate on the listings before and after so you can see the effect on your own account.


## Copywriting & Content Writing
https://gaa-tha.com/services/content-writing-copywriting
Last updated: 2026-09-25

gaa-tha writes copy and content that sells and ranks: website and landing-page copy, product titles, bullets and descriptions for catalogues of 200+ SKUs, ad copy variations, reel and film scripts, blog articles and FAQs, brochure and catalogue copy, and B2B and export sales copy, written for buyers first and for Google and AI assistants second, in English, Hindi or Gujarati.

Best for: D2C and marketplace brands, manufacturers and exporters, real estate, education and services businesses

Engagement model: Per project or monthly content retainer
Channels/platforms: Websites, Amazon and Flipkart listings, Meta and Google ads, reels, blogs, brochures, IndiaMART, LinkedIn

### What it is
Copywriting is writing whose job is to make someone act — click, enquire, add to cart, reply — while content writing is writing whose job is to inform and build trust over time, such as articles, guides and FAQs. Both need the same things: a clear understanding of the buyer, a specific promise, and language plain enough to be quoted.

gaa-tha writes both from a single brand voice document, so a product bullet on Amazon, a Meta ad, a reel script and a blog answer all sound like the same company. Every piece is written answer-first and entity-rich so it reads well to a buyer, ranks on Google, and can be cited by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity — the same approach we use on gaa-tha.com.

### What's included
- Website and landing-page copy: home, services, about, product and campaign pages
- Product titles, bullets and descriptions for Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify and quick commerce, including 200+ SKU catalogues
- Ad copy variations for Meta, Google and WhatsApp campaigns
- Reel, video and cinema ad scripts with hooks and CTAs
- Blog articles, guides and FAQ pages written for SEO, AEO and GEO
- Brochure, catalogue and company-profile copy
- B2B and export sales copy: email sequences, IndiaMART listings, LinkedIn posts
- Tone of voice document and messaging pillars
- Hindi and Gujarati versions and transcreation

### How we work
1. Voice and audience — We read what you already have, interview the founders or sales team, and write a short tone of voice and messaging document everyone works from.
2. Research — For each piece we gather product facts, customer questions, competitor language and search terms, so the writing is specific rather than generic.
3. Write — First drafts are written answer-first, with headlines, hooks and CTAs, and structured for the channel — a listing, a landing page, a script or an article.
4. Review — Two rounds of revisions with your team; facts, claims and mandatory text are checked, and product data is reconciled to your master sheet.
5. Publish and measure — Copy is handed over in the format each platform needs, or uploaded by our teams, and we watch rankings, click-through and conversion to refine it.

### Deliverables
- Tone of voice and messaging document
- Final copy in Google Docs, or a structured sheet for bulk listings
- Ad copy sets with variations labelled for testing
- Scripts with shot notes for reels and films
- SEO/AEO-ready articles with titles, meta descriptions and FAQ blocks
- Translations or transcreations in Hindi and Gujarati

Tools & platforms: Google Docs, Google Sheets, Notion, Grammarly, Semrush, Google Search Console, Amazon Seller Central, ChatGPT
Pricing model: Per-piece or per-project fee for websites, catalogues and scripts, or a monthly content retainer for brands that need listings, ads and articles every month; volumes and languages set the scope.

### FAQ
Q: What is the difference between copywriting and content writing?
A: Copywriting persuades: ads, landing pages, product listings, emails, scripts. Content writing informs and builds trust: articles, guides, FAQs, case studies. Most brands need both, and gaa-tha writes both from the same tone of voice document so the brand sounds consistent.

Q: Can you write product listings for hundreds of SKUs?

Catalogues of 200 or more SKUs are handled in weekly batches with a style guide so every listing reads the same.

Q: Do you write for SEO and AI search?
A: Yes. Every article, service page and FAQ is written answer-first, with clear headings, named entities and structured data in mind, so it ranks on Google and can be cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Our SEO, AEO and GEO team sets the keywords and questions; the writers make the answers worth quoting.

Q: Do you use AI to write?
A: We use AI tools for research, outlines, variations and first-pass translation, and human writers for the thinking, the facts, the voice and the final draft. Nothing is published without a person checking claims, tone and accuracy, and copy is never left sounding generic.

Q: Can you write in Hindi and Gujarati?
A: Yes. We write and transcreate in Hindi and Gujarati for ads, packaging, reels and WhatsApp campaigns, with native speakers reviewing each version, which matters for brands selling in Gujarat and across tier-2 India.

Q: How long does website copy take?
A: One to three weeks for a corporate or D2C site, depending on the number of pages and how quickly interviews and approvals happen. Individual pieces such as an ad set, a script or an article take two to five days.

Q: What do you need from us to start?
A: Your existing website and materials, product data, a short conversation with the founder or sales lead about customers and objections, brand guidelines if they exist, and a list of the pieces you need first. From that we write the voice document and start drafting.

Q: Do you write B2B and export sales copy?
A: Yes. Company profiles, IndiaMART and Alibaba listings, cold email sequences, LinkedIn posts and export brochures for manufacturers and exporters are a regular part of the work, written to answer a procurement buyer's questions — capacity, certifications, MOQ, lead time — plainly.

### What it is
A sales kit is the set of documents a business uses to win an order: a product catalogue, a company profile, a pitch or investor deck, a price list and the brochures a buyer takes away from a meeting or a trade fair. Its job is to answer a buyer's questions — who are you, what do you make, at what capacity, at what price, and why should I trust you — before the salesperson gets a second call.

gaa-tha designs these as one family, so the catalogue, profile and deck share the same structure, photography and tone, and can be updated without a redesign. Documents are built to be sent on WhatsApp and email as light PDFs, printed properly for a sales meet or Diwali distribution, and reused as IndiaMART and LinkedIn assets — with the product data kept in a sheet so price and SKU changes are a quick edit.

### What's included

### FAQ
Q: What should a product catalogue include?
A: A short company introduction, a clear product index, one page or block per product or range with images, specifications, pack sizes and codes, certifications and compliance details, and how to order. Price lists are usually kept separate so the catalogue stays current when rates change. gaa-tha structures the catalogue around how your buyers actually search and order.

Q: How long does a catalogue or deck take?
A: One to three weeks depending on page count, the number of SKUs and whether photography and copy already exist. A company profile or pitch deck sits at the short end; a catalogue of 100 or more SKUs with new photography at the long end.

Q: Can you design a pitch deck or investor deck?

Q: Do you also write the copy and shoot the products?
A: Yes, if you need it. Our copywriting and product photography teams produce what is missing, so a manufacturer can hand over a price list and a factory tour and receive a finished catalogue.

Q: Can you make it easy to update prices and SKUs?
A: Yes. Product data lives in a master sheet, price lists are designed as separate inserts or linked tables, and you receive editable files, so a rate change is an edit rather than a redesign. For frequent changes we offer a small update retainer.

Q: Will the same catalogue work for export buyers?
A: With adjustments. Export brochures need certifications, capacity, MOQ, lead times, packaging and Incoterms visible, and imagery that reads well to buyers in the Gulf, Europe or the US. We produce an export version alongside the domestic catalogue where needed.

Q: What format do we get for WhatsApp and IndiaMART?

Q: Do you handle printing?

# Growth Marketing

Strategy, content and ads that turn attention into revenue.

## FAQ
Q: What is growth marketing?
A: Growth marketing is the practice of using strategy, content and paid media together to grow a measurable business number — leads, orders, footfall or revenue — rather than running channels in isolation. gaa-tha plans the channels to one budget and reports on outcomes, not impressions.

Q: Which channel should I start with?
A: It depends on where your buyers already look. Retail and D2C brands usually start with Meta ads and Instagram content; B2B and manufacturers with Google Search, LinkedIn and marketplace listings; local businesses with Google Business Profile. Q: How do you report results?

Q: Can you run everything together?

## Marketing Strategy & Positioning
https://gaa-tha.com/services/marketing-strategy
Last updated: 2026-09-25

gaa-tha's marketing strategy and positioning service decides who your brand serves, why buyers should choose you, which channels deserve budget and what success looks like in numbers — before any creative is made. Delivered in two to three weeks as a written strategy, a 90-day roadmap and a KPI framework your team and ours execute against.

Best for: Founders and marketing heads at D2C, FMCG, retail, manufacturing and real-estate brands before a launch or a budget decision
Timeline: 2–3 weeks
Engagement model: One-time project, often followed by an execution retainer
Channels/platforms: Channel-agnostic — covers social, Meta and Google ads, search, marketplaces and offline

### What it is
A marketing strategy is the set of choices about who you serve, what you promise, which channels you will use and how success will be measured — written down before any campaign starts. It is not a content calendar or a list of posts; those are tactics, and strategy is what makes the tactics agree with each other.

At gaa-tha the strategy phase starts with research, not opinion: your market, your competitors, the people who already buy from you and the reasons they give. From that we write the positioning, the messaging, the offer, the channel plan with a budget split, a 90-day roadmap and the KPI framework — so every rupee spent afterwards has a job.

### What's included
- Market and competitor research — category, pricing, claims, channels and gaps
- Customer interviews and audience personas with buying triggers and objections
- Positioning statement and messaging hierarchy (promise, proof points, tone)
- Offer design — what you sell, at what price point, with what hook
- Channel plan and budget split across social, Meta and Google ads, search, marketplaces and offline
- 90-day roadmap with owners, milestones and content and campaign priorities
- KPI framework — one primary number per objective, with targets and a reporting cadence
- Founder and sales-team workshop to align on the strategy before execution
- Creative and content brief for the team executing the plan

### How we work
1. Discovery — A working session with the founders and sales team on goals, margins, current channels and what has and has not worked, plus access to analytics and ad accounts.
2. Research — We study the category, competitors, search demand and customer conversations, and interview a handful of existing customers to hear the words they use.
3. Positioning and offer — We write the positioning, the messaging hierarchy and the offer, and test them against the alternatives your buyers are already considering.
4. Channel plan and roadmap — Channels are ranked by where your buyers actually look, budget is split accordingly, and a 90-day roadmap sets the order of work.
5. Workshop and handover — The strategy is presented to your team, questions are worked through live, and the KPI framework and briefs are handed to whoever executes — us or your in-house team.

### Deliverables
- Marketing strategy document (research, positioning, messaging, offer)
- Audience personas with triggers, objections and channel habits
- Channel plan with budget split and expected roles per channel
- 90-day roadmap with owners and milestones
- KPI framework and a reporting template
- Creative and content brief for execution

Tools & platforms: Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Trends, Meta Ads Library, Semrush, Google Sheets, Notion
Pricing model: One-time project fee scoped to the depth of research and the number of markets or product lines; execution can follow as a monthly retainer.

### FAQ
Q: What is a marketing strategy?
A: A marketing strategy is the set of choices about who you serve, what you stand for and how you will reach them, written down before any campaign starts. It answers four questions: which segment, what promise, which channels, and what success looks like in numbers. gaa-tha delivers it as a document, a roadmap and a KPI framework rather than a slide deck that gets filed away.

Q: How long does a marketing strategy take?
A: Two to three weeks for most Indian SMEs and D2C brands: one week of discovery and research, one week of positioning and channel planning, and a few days for the workshop and handover. Brands with several product lines or export markets may need an extra week of research.

Q: Do I need a strategy before running ads or social media?
A: Yes, at least a short one. Without agreed positioning, an offer and a primary metric, ads and content are tested against nothing, and money goes to whatever looks busy. A two-week strategy phase typically saves far more than it costs in wasted spend and redone creative.

Q: What is the difference between a marketing strategy and a marketing plan?
A: Strategy is the choices — audience, promise, channels, success metric. A plan is the schedule of activity that follows from those choices: which posts, which campaigns, which months. gaa-tha delivers both: the strategy document and a 90-day roadmap that turns it into work.

Q: How much should a business spend on marketing?
A: A common working range is 5–10% of revenue for established businesses and 15–20% for brands in a launch or growth phase, but the better question is what a customer is worth to you. We calculate customer lifetime value and a target cost per acquisition in the strategy phase, and the budget follows those two numbers.

Q: Can you also execute the strategy?
A: Yes. Social media, Meta and Google ads, SEO/AEO/GEO, influencer campaigns and creative are all in-house, so most clients move from the strategy project into a monthly execution retainer with the same team. If you have an in-house team or another agency, the strategy and briefs are written so they can execute it.

Q: What do you need from us to start?
A: Two or three hours of founder and sales-team time for discovery, access to your analytics, ad accounts and sales data, and introductions to a few customers we can interview. Everything else — research, competitor analysis and drafting — is on us.


## Social Media Marketing
https://gaa-tha.com/services/social-media-marketing
Last updated: 2026-09-25

gaa-tha is a social media marketing agency in India that runs Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube for brands on a monthly retainer: platform strategy, a content calendar planned around your launches and seasons, posts, carousels and reels produced in-house, community management and page collaborations, reported on reach, engagement, profile visits and website clicks or footfall.

Best for: Retail, D2C, FMCG, real estate, education, and B2B brands on LinkedIn
Timeline: Onboarding in 2 weeks, then monthly
Engagement model: Monthly retainer scoped to platforms and content volume
Channels/platforms: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, WhatsApp Channels

### What it is
Social media marketing is the ongoing work of building and engaging an audience on platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube through planned content, community management and collaborations, so that followers become enquiries, footfall and customers. It is different from paid ads: ads buy attention for a day, while social content earns an audience that keeps paying back.

At gaa-tha social media is planned backwards from your business calendar — launches, festive seasons, sale periods, exhibitions — and forward from what your audience already watches. Reels, carousels, statics and copy are produced by one in-house team with AI-assisted production where it helps, and every month is reported against reach, engagement, profile visits and the clicks or footfall that matter to you.

### What's included
- Platform strategy — which of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube deserve effort, and what each is for
- Content pillars, tone of voice and a monthly content calendar planned around launches and seasons
- Posts, carousels, statics and reels produced in-house, including scripting, shooting or AI ad shoots and editing
- Copywriting, captions, hashtags and hooks in English, Hindi or Gujarati as needed
- Community management — replies to comments and DMs within agreed hours, with escalation rules
- Page collaborations and cross-posting with partner brands, creators and local pages
- Profile optimisation — bio, highlights, link-in-bio, LinkedIn company page sections
- Trend and format monitoring so the calendar can react within the month
- Monthly report on reach, engagement, follower growth, profile visits and website clicks or footfall

### How we work
1. Audit and strategy — We review your current profiles, best-performing content and competitors, then set the platforms, pillars, posting cadence and the one number each platform is run against.
2. Calendar and briefs — A monthly calendar is built around your launches, seasons and sales goals, with a brief for every reel, carousel and post before production starts.
3. Production — Content is shot, designed, written and edited in batches by the in-house team — on-ground shoots, AI ad shoots or a mix — and sent for approval in one round.
4. Publish and engage — Posts go out on schedule, comments and DMs are handled within agreed hours, and collaborations with partner pages and creators are coordinated.
5. Report and adjust — A monthly report shows what moved reach, saves, profile visits and clicks; the next calendar is adjusted around what worked.

### FAQ
Q: What does a social media marketing agency do?
A: A social media marketing agency plans, produces, publishes and reports on a brand's content across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube, and manages the comments and messages that content generates. gaa-tha runs this as a monthly retainer with one in-house team for strategy, shooting, design, editing and reporting.

Q: How many posts a month do we need?
A: Enough to stay consistent, not enough to burn out the team or the audience. For most brands that is three to five reels and eight to twelve feed posts a month on the primary platform, with LinkedIn at two to three posts a week for B2B. We set the cadence from your goals and content sources during onboarding rather than a fixed package.

Q: Which platform should we start with?
A: Instagram for retail, D2C, food, beauty, real estate and most consumer brands in India; LinkedIn for manufacturers, exporters and B2B services; YouTube when your product needs longer explanation or demonstration. Facebook still matters for tier-2 and tier-3 audiences and for older buyers. We usually recommend doing one platform properly before adding a second.

Q: Do you shoot the content or do we need to send footage?
A: We shoot it. On-ground shoots at your store, factory or site are planned monthly, and AI ad shoots cover product visuals when a physical shoot is impractical. Founders who want to appear on camera get scripts and direction; those who do not can use an AI clone with consent.

Q: How do you measure whether social media is working?
A: By one primary metric per objective, agreed upfront: reach and follower growth for awareness, saves, shares and profile visits for consideration, and website clicks, WhatsApp enquiries or store footfall for revenue. Likes and follower counts are tracked as diagnostics, never as the goal.

Q: Will you reply to comments and DMs?
A: Yes. Community management is part of the retainer, with agreed response hours, reply templates for common questions and an escalation rule so pricing, complaints and leads reach your team the same day.

Q: Do we still need ads if we do organic social media?
A: Usually yes, in a small way. Organic content builds trust and an audience; a modest boosting or Meta ads budget makes the best content reach people who do not follow you yet. The two are planned together so the best-performing reels become ads.

Q: How long before social media shows results?
A: Consistent engagement and profile-visit growth usually show within the first two to three months; enquiries and footfall follow once the audience and the content formats have settled. Social media compounds, which is why it runs as a monthly retainer rather than a one-off campaign.

Q: What does a Google Ads agency do?

Q: Do I need a landing page or can ads go to my homepage?

It works well once conversion tracking is clean and there is some history; we usually start with Search and Shopping, then add Performance Max with brand exclusions so it does not just buy your own name.


## SEO, AEO & GEO
https://gaa-tha.com/services/seo-aeo-geo
Last updated: 2026-09-25

gaa-tha is an SEO, AEO and GEO agency in India that helps brands rank on Google, get chosen in Google AI Overviews and featured snippets, and get recommended inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity — through technical SEO, keyword and question research, on-page and schema work, answer-first content, digital PR and AI-visibility tracking, run as a monthly retainer.

Best for: Brands, B2B companies and D2C stores whose buyers research on Google and ask AI assistants before buying
Timeline: 3–6 months for SEO; AEO and GEO quick wins in weeks
Engagement model: Monthly retainer
Channels/platforms: Google Search, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Bing

### What it is
SEO, AEO and GEO are three layers of search visibility: SEO (search engine optimisation) gets a website ranked in classic Google results, AEO (answer engine optimisation) gets it chosen as the direct answer in AI Overviews, featured snippets and voice assistants, and GEO (generative engine optimisation) gets the brand cited and recommended inside AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity. All three reward the same thing — clear, structured, consistent and corroborated information.

At gaa-tha the three are one programme. Technical SEO and keyword research build the base; answer-first pages, FAQs and schema make the site quotable; digital PR, citations and consistent business data across the web make it trustworthy. We track rankings and AI citations side by side, because your next customer may never see a classic results page.

### What's included
- Technical SEO audit — crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, mobile, duplicate and thin pages
- Keyword and question research grouped by intent, including the questions people ask AI assistants
- On-page optimisation — titles, headings, internal links, images and answer-first rewrites
- Schema and structured data (Organization, Service, Product, FAQPage, Article, LocalBusiness)
- FAQ and answer content written to be quoted out of context
- Content clusters — pillar pages and supporting posts planned and written monthly
- Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation where you have a physical location
- Digital PR, directory citations and consistent business facts across LinkedIn, GBP and listings
- llms.txt, XML sitemap and robots configuration so AI crawlers can read the site
- Monthly report on rankings, organic traffic, leads and AI-assistant citations

### How we work
1. Audit and baseline — We crawl the site, check Search Console and analytics, and record current rankings and whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity mention you for your core questions.
2. Research and plan — Keywords and questions are mapped by intent and buying stage, and a six-month content and fix roadmap is agreed with priorities.
3. Technical and on-page fixes — Speed, indexing and structure issues are fixed, key pages are rewritten answer-first, and schema, sitemap and llms.txt are added.
4. Content and authority — Pillar pages, FAQs and posts are published on a monthly cadence, and citations, directory listings and PR mentions are built to corroborate the facts.
5. Track and compound — Rankings, traffic, leads and AI citations are reported monthly, and the plan is adjusted to whatever is moving fastest.

### Deliverables
- Technical SEO audit with a prioritised fix list
- Keyword and question map by intent
- Optimised pages with schema, FAQs and internal linking
- Monthly content — pillar pages, posts and FAQ additions
- llms.txt, XML sitemap and structured-data files
- Monthly ranking, traffic, lead and AI-visibility report

Tools & platforms: Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, PageSpeed Insights, Schema.org markup, Looker Studio
Pricing model: Monthly retainer scoped to site size, content volume and the number of locations or markets; no rankings are guaranteed and no ranking-for-fee schemes are used.

### FAQ
Q: What is the difference between SEO, AEO and GEO?
A: SEO gets you ranked in classic search results. AEO (answer engine optimisation) gets you chosen as the direct answer in Google AI Overviews, featured snippets and voice assistants. GEO (generative engine optimisation) gets your brand cited and recommended inside AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity. gaa-tha optimises for all three in one programme.

Q: How long does SEO take to show results?
A: Meaningful movement typically shows in three to six months, with compounding gains after that. AEO and GEO can move faster — structured answers, FAQs and schema are often picked up by AI engines within weeks. We pair the slow burn with quick wins so growth never stalls.

Q: How do I get my brand recommended by ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini?
A: AI assistants recommend brands with clear, structured, consistent and widely corroborated information: answer-first pages, schema markup, genuine FAQs, consistent business facts across the web, third-party mentions and reviews. We structure your site and content so generative engines can understand, trust and cite you, and track whether they do.

Q: Do you guarantee first-page rankings?
A: No, and nobody honestly can — Google and AI engines control the results. What we commit to is the work: fixes shipped, pages published, citations built, and a monthly report showing rankings, traffic, leads and AI mentions moving. Guaranteed rankings are one of the red flags we tell clients to walk away from.

Q: What is llms.txt and do I need one?
A: llms.txt is a plain-text file at the root of a website that summarises what the site is about and links to its most important pages, written for AI crawlers and assistants. It costs little to add and makes it easier for AI tools to read and cite you correctly, so every site we build or optimise ships with one.

Q: Do we need a blog or regular content?
A: Yes, if you want to be found for the questions buyers ask rather than only your brand name. Content marketing is the fuel for SEO, AEO and GEO: keyword and question research, authoritative articles and FAQs with structured data, then distribution on social. One insight becomes a post, a reel, a carousel and an ad.

Q: Should I do SEO or Google Ads first?
A: Both, if budget allows — ads for demand this month, SEO for demand that compounds. If you must choose, start with Google Ads to learn which keywords convert, then invest in SEO for those terms so paid and organic reinforce each other.

Q: How do you track AI visibility?
A: By running a fixed set of buyer questions through ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews each month and recording whether your brand is mentioned, cited or recommended, alongside classic rankings and Search Console data. The report shows both, so you can see search and AI visibility move together.


## Local SEO & Google Business Profile
https://gaa-tha.com/services/local-seo-google-business-profile
Last updated: 2026-09-25

gaa-tha's local SEO service gets stores, showrooms, clinics, PGs and factories found in "near me" searches and on Google Maps: Google Business Profile setup and optimisation, categories, services, products and weekly posts, photo uploads, review generation and responses, consistent name-address-phone listings across directories, and local landing pages for each city or outlet.

### What it is
Local SEO is the work of making a business appear when people nearby search for what it offers — in Google's map pack, on Google Maps and in "near me" results — by optimising its Google Business Profile, earning and answering reviews, keeping its name, address and phone number consistent across the web, and building location pages on its website. For a store, clinic, PG or showroom it is often the highest-return marketing there is.

At gaa-tha local SEO starts with the Google Business Profile, because that is what buyers see first: the right categories, complete services and products, current photos, weekly posts and a review process your staff can actually follow. For businesses with several outlets or cities we build a local landing page per location and manage every profile from one place.

- Primary and secondary categories, service areas, attributes, opening hours and booking or WhatsApp links

- Review generation — QR codes, WhatsApp templates and staff scripts — plus replies to every review

- Duplicate, suspension and ownership issue resolution with Google support

### How we work

3. Content and photos — Fresh photos and short videos are shot and uploaded, service descriptions are rewritten with local keywords, and the first month of posts is scheduled.
4. Reviews and citations — A review process is set up with your staff — QR codes at the counter, WhatsApp follow-ups — and your listings are aligned across directories.
5. Report and maintain — Monthly reporting on map-pack visibility, calls and direction requests, with ongoing posts, review replies and Q&A handled on retainer.
